stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"The money-market-fund guide compares with one named bank (Leumi) and cites that bank's deposit rate, in a page about a general product.","where":"the comparison lines and their source","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: The phrase "סיכון נמוך שהלווה לא יחזיר" in the summary was confusing at first
The "123 מקור / חושב / הזנה" row wasn't understood and looked like something for the site's builders
The 10% foreign-securities sentence leaves it unclear when sale money reaches the account
The open question about whether Friday trading is possible bothered the reader
The fee comes off the price daily and never shows as a separate charge, which is worrying
The closed "שחקו עם המספרים שלכם" box gave no hint of what it would answer
Small code labels (TXS-24, MF-16, etc.) mean nothing; the reader would drop them
Unclear how to tell which 2 of the 73 funds pay the tax themselves
No state guarantee on the fund and no insurance on deposits was sobering
The colours of the comparison bars are unexplained, and equal bars add nothing beyond the numbers
Unclear why the renewing fund (קרן כספית מתחדשת) is greyed out
"אין תקרה בחוק" on almost every cost line was a little scary
The cost section has no actual amounts, only "set by the provider"
"מסלקה" and the actual cut-off hour aren't explained
Real vs nominal gain, and what the site calculates and where, is unclear
Redemption suspension in unusual cases: when and how often hasn't been explained
The ISA average fee figure is mentioned but the number isn't shown
No shekel example of 3.25% minus fees minus tax
Missing: whether a money-market fund has ever lost money in Israel
Missing: how to choose one fund out of 73
Missing: whether it can be bought at one's own bank or needs a brokerage account
Missing: whether there is a minimum investment
Missing: whether the investor must report tax themselves
Would drop the "מה האתר לקח בחשבון" section
Would cut most of the glossary
Would drop the "חוקים וכללים" column in the cost table

problems.why: The reader quotes the comparison box's note naming Discount bank without objecting, and never complains that a general guide names or cites a particular bank, Leumi or any other.
